- Vs -
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Indranuj Dutta, Ms. Benazir Sk.

...  for the petitioners The present revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of the impugned proceeding being G.R. Case No. 1085 of 2025 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bolpur, Birbhum arising out of Bolpur Police Station Case No. 323 of 2025 dated 19.07.2025 under Section 85 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and all orders passed therein in connection with the instant case.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bolpur, Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Bolpur Police Station Case No. 323 of 2025
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that this is a second FIR under Section 498A of IPC filed by the defacto complainant.
It appears from the materials on record that the first FIR No. 151 of 2022 under Section 498A, was registered on 22.05.2022.
Considering the said fact and the materials on record and considering the offences alleged, the petitioners have made out a prima facie case for hearing of the revisional application.
Accordingly the petitioners shall serve upon the opposite party including the State and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing before the regular Bench.

Pending hearing of the revisional application the proceedings of G.R. Case No. 1085 of 2025 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bolpur, Birbhum arising out of Bolpur Police Station Case No. 323 of 2025 dated 19.07.2025 under Section 85 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 be stayed till 28th April, 2026 or until further order whichever is earlier.
